answer: The sources do not give one defect liability period for this work. The only defect liability period stated is in the CPWD General Conditions of Contract 2020 (Clause 17), which applies twelve months, or six months for work costing Rs. 10 lakh and below except road work [S2]. Since the cost of this work is not stated, I cannot say which period applies.
